_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior window prime+paint (wood, aluminum-clad, vinyl-clad, new construction). Context prefix XWIN (eXterior WINdow) -- no collision with existing prefixes. Interior window uses WIN_ prefix. Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). 3 paintable items by size bucket (S/M/L), all EA-based. 3 cladding types with distinct primer paths. 6 window types as configuration dimension. QT3-QT5 (QT2 excluded -- exterior windows are visible architectural elements).

paintable_items.name: Exterior window -- small (glass area < 6 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Small exterior window assembly: frame, sash, muntins (if TDL/SDL). Covers awning, casement, fixed window types that fall in the small size bucket. EA-based -- one count per window unit.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window -- medium (glass area 6-15 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Medium exterior window assembly. Most common size bucket for standard double-hung and casement windows. Calibration baseline for production rates.

paintable_items.name: Exterior window -- large (glass area > 15 SF)
paintable_items.notes: Large exterior window assembly including bay and bow windows (always L bucket). Bay/bow counted as 1 EA each despite multi-sash geometry -- window_type modifier drives the elevated per-EA rate.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM (interior), WIN (interior window), STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, XTRM, XDOR. XWIN is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_XWIN_{ACTION} -- action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_XWIN_MASK_GLASS, TSK_XWIN_REMOVE_HARDWARE, TSK_XWIN_SAND_PREP_WOOD, TSK_XWIN_SCUFF_SAND_ALUM, TSK_XWIN_CLEAN_VINYL, TSK_XWIN_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_XWIN_FINISH_BRUSH_1, TSK_XWIN_SAND_INTERCOAT, TSK_XWIN_SASH_SEQUENCE, TSK_XWIN_GLASS_LAP

expected_modules.notes: Glass masking (tape-and-film or liquid mask per Low-E status and muntin type), hardware removal (locks, lifts, sash pulls), weatherstrip protection, sill protection, equipment staging. Masking time varies: single-lite 0.08-0.12 hrs/EA vs TDL 0.20-0.50 hrs/EA.

Cladding-specific prep: wood = sand mill glaze 120-150 grit + fill defects + spot-prime knots. Aluminum-clad = scuff-sand entire surface 180-220 grit + TSP wash. Vinyl-clad = TSP substitute clean only (no sanding). Seal end-grain on all wood sash edges.

3 cladding paths: wood = acrylic exterior primer (SYS_EXT_WIN_PRIMER_ACRYLIC) + alkyd spot-prime for tannin-rich species. Aluminum-clad = corrosion-inhibiting primer (SYS_EXT_WIN_PRIMER_CORROSION). Vinyl-clad = PVC bonding primer (SYS_EXT_WIN_PRIMER_BONDING_PVC). Conditional on substrate_state -- SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD skips. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: wood skips, aluminum/vinyl still require field prime.

First finish coat -- brush (primary) or spray (whole-house context). Glass lap 1/16 inch overlap onto glass is MANDATORY. Brush sequence: horizontal rails first, then vertical stiles (with the grain).
QT3: visual inspect only. QT4: light sand 220-grit + raking light inspection. QT5: hand-sand 220-320 grit + raking light at multiple angles + DFT verification.
Second finish coat -- same method as first coat. Glass lap verified.

Double-hung specific blocking prevention module. Sash reversal: pull upper down, push lower up to expose hidden rails. Leave 1 inch gap top and bottom during drying. Periodically move sashes during drying. NEVER PAINT: sliding channels (pulley stiles), weatherstripping, sash cords. Lubricate with light wax. Applies only when window_type = double_hung.
Final inspection, glass lap verification, touch-up. QT5: raking light at multiple angles.
Glass masking removal, hardware reinstall, weatherstrip re-insert, sill protection teardown, tool cleaning.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of small exterior windows (glass area < 6 SF). Visual categorization during exterior walkthrough.
paintscope_keys.notes: Interior window spec uses PS_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_S. Exterior uses PS_EXT_OPENING_EA prefix to distinguish domain.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of medium exterior windows (glass area 6-15 SF). Calibration baseline for production rates.
Count of large exterior windows (glass area > 15 SF). Includes bay and bow windows (always forced into L bucket).
Window type classification. PRIMARY production rate driver alongside size bucket. Values: awning, casement, double_hung, fixed, bay, bow.
paintscope_keys.notes: Per-window attribute. A project may have mixed window types. Double-hung requires sash reversal SOP module. Bay/bow are multi-sash assemblies.

paintscope_keys.description: Window cladding material. Drives primer system, prep protocol, and topcoat restrictions. Values: wood, aluminum_clad, vinyl_clad.
paintscope_keys.notes: Project-level default with per-window override possible. Vinyl-clad imposes VinylSafe IR-reflective color restriction (LRV >= 55 standard, >= 35-40 with VinylSafe).

paintscope_keys.description: Muntin/grille type. Modifier for masking and painting labor. Values: none, tdl, sdl, gbg.
paintscope_keys.notes: TDL = 1.50-2.00x production multiplier (individual pane masking + muntin bar painting). SDL = 1.25x (applied bars painted, single pane behind). GBG/none = 1.00 (no effect). Liquid mask permitted for TDL on non-Low-E glass.

paintscope_keys.description: Low-E glass status. HARD STOP for masking method: Low-E = true prohibits liquid masking (scoring damages Low-E coating). Tape-and-film method only.
paintscope_keys.notes: Most NC windows have Low-E glass. This flag gates the masking method decision at scope time.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag confirming new construction context.
paintscope_keys.notes: Already registered by sibling exterior specs.

paintscope_keys.description: Access type per elevation. HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for windows. Ground = 1.00, ladder = 1.20, scaffold = 1.43. Applied to ALL window painting tasks.
paintscope_keys.notes: Windows are frequently elevated (2nd/3rd story). Height modifier is more impactful here than for doors (typically ground level).

paintscope_keys.description: Count of windows requiring glass masking. Typically 1:1 with total window count. Masking time varies by muntin_type: single-lite 0.08-0.12 hrs/EA, TDL 0.20-0.50 hrs/EA.
paintscope_keys.notes: Distinct from PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.GLASS_DOOR (door spec's glass masking). This is glass IN the window assembly.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded -- exterior windows are visible architectural elements. QT5 justified for historic-style TDL windows, showcase properties.

application_method.notes: Brush is PRIMARY for window painting -- precision required for 1/16 inch glass lap, sash sequence, cutting in around glass. Spray is CONDITIONAL (whole-house spray context only -- adds masking overhead). Roller is NOT valid for window components.

sheen.notes: No locked-in default -- project-level selection. Windows follow trim-class sheen. Higher sheen = more durable but reveals surface imperfections. Gloss requires higher prep quality.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase -- uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA is primary UOM for all 3 window size items. FIXED for per-project fixed tasks (tool cleaning). Rates are hours/EA. No SF or LF direct -- everything bundled into per-EA rate by size bucket.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD is dominant for wood windows. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY is dominant for aluminum-clad and vinyl-clad. SS_EXT_BARE_METAL is NOT applicable -- window cladding is never bare metal. For aluminum/vinyl clad: field prime MANDATORY even over factory finish (adhesion promotion required). SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD skips prime entirely.

product_role.notes: Specialty for VinylSafe IR-reflective coating (vinyl-clad dark colors). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Full_mask for glass panes. Light_mask for adjacent casing and siding. Hardware is REMOVED (not masked).

surface_ids.notes: window_frame_sash_ext is proposed (new exterior-specific surface). ext_trim_window_casing and siding_field exist in registry. window_glass exists in registry. ext_sill is proposed (exterior sill, distinct from interior window_stool). window_interior is proposed (scope boundary reference to SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1). Existing window_frame/window_sash are interior-focused.

zone_ids.notes: Glass pane masking in window assembly. HDPE static-cling film for standard single-lite. Tape-and-film for Low-E glass. Liquid mask for TDL non-Low-E only. Masking time varies dramatically by muntin_type.
Window locks, lifts, sash pulls. REMOVED before painting (not masked). Bag and label per window. Reinstall after final coat dry. Fixed windows have no operable hardware.
Weatherstripping on operable sashes. NEVER PAINT weatherstripping. Remove friction-fit or deep-tape non-removable. Fixed windows have no weatherstripping.
Exterior window sill protection from drips during window painting. Reusing existing sill_protection zone_id from registry.
Protect finished casing from window painting drips. Light tape at casing-to-frame junction. Only when casing is already finished.
Protect finished siding adjacent to window. Upgrades from light_mask to full_mask when application_method = spray. Minimal concern for brush-applied work.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_ACRYLIC -- interior acrylic wood primer, similar concept but interior-specific
SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_SHELLAC -- interior shellac knot/tannin primer, same concept for spot-priming
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC -- exterior acrylic primer for siding, same chemistry
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN -- exterior tannin-blocking primer for siding
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING -- interior bonding primer for smooth substrates, similar PVC adhesion concept

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Primer for Wood Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Standard exterior primer for bare wood window frames and sashes. Penetrates into wood grain. For tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood), supplement with alkyd spot-prime at knots.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Spot-applied to visible knots on tannin-rich species. Not a full-surface system. Applied before full acrylic primer coat.

proposed_systems.name: Corrosion-Inhibiting Primer for Aluminum-Clad Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Industrial-grade corrosion-inhibiting primer (e.g., SW Pro-Cryl). MANDATORY for aluminum-clad even over factory finish. Must be applied over mechanical bonding profile (180-220 grit sanding).

proposed_systems.name: PVC Bonding Primer for Vinyl-Clad Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Specialized PVC bonding primer (e.g., INSL-X STIX). MANDATORY for vinyl-clad even over factory finish. Must be recoated within 1 week or loses flexibility. Standard primers will not bond to vinyl.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior trim enamel. Hard enamel for UV resistance. Flexible for thermal expansion. 2 finish coats standard.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Urethane-Modified Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
proposed_systems.notes: Premium exterior trim enamel (SW Emerald Urethane Trim Enamel, BM Aura). QT5: self-leveling for brush-mark-free finish on detailed muntin work. Maximum hardness, gloss retention, UV resistance.

proposed_systems.name: VinylSafe IR-Reflective Exterior Enamel for Vinyl-Clad Windows
proposed_systems.notes: MANDATORY for vinyl-clad windows when color LRV < 55. IR-reflective Complex Inorganic Color Pigments (CICPs) drop surface temperature 20-30 deg F. SW VinylSafe Color Technology palette (100 colors). Without VinylSafe: standard paint LRV must be 55+ to avoid warping/buckling.

material_system_prefix.notes: 4 substrate-driven primers (acrylic for wood, tannin spot for wood knots, corrosion-inhibiting for aluminum, PVC bonding for vinyl) + 2 QT-driven finish systems + 1 mandatory VinylSafe IR-reflective for vinyl-clad dark colors. Window finish is exterior trim grade.

proposed_consumables.name: HDPE Static-Cling Glass Masking Film
proposed_consumables.notes: Static-cling HDPE film for glass pane masking. Faster than tape-and-paper. Secondary tape line to prevent film flutter from wind.

proposed_consumables.name: Liquid Glass Masking Product
proposed_consumables.notes: Brush-on liquid mask for TDL muntin windows. Cures into protective membrane. Score trim line and peel post-painting. PROHIBITED on Low-E glass.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 211 (window precision)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.011 inch orifice for precision on small window surfaces. Used only in whole-house spray context. 200-mesh red filter.

proposed_consumables.name: Sash Lubricant (light wax or linseed oil)
proposed_consumables.notes: Applied to unpainted sliding channels (pulley stiles) and other contact points. Prevents sash binding. NEVER paint these surfaces.

proposed_consumables.name: Glazing Putty (Sarco Dual Glaze)
proposed_consumables.notes: For reglazing task (conditional, wood windows with traditional glazing only). Sarco Dual Glaze recommended. Avoid big-box putties.

proposed_consumables.name: TSP Substitute Cleaner
proposed_consumables.notes: For aluminum-clad (remove oxidation/chalking) and vinyl-clad (general clean) prep. Non-phosphate formula.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats -- standard NC for bare wood and aluminum/vinyl clad (mandatory field prime)
proposed_configurations.notes: SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY on aluminum/vinyl clad STILL requires field prime (adhesion promotion). Only SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY on WOOD skips prime.

proposed_configurations.description: 2 finish coats only -- factory-primed wood (adequate factory primer) or field-primed any cladding
Factory-primed wood -- skip field prime, direct to 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Wood factory primer is adequate base for topcoat (unlike aluminum/vinyl clad).

round_configurations.notes: Existing ROUND_WIN_ configurations are for interior window spec. Exterior window rounds need XWIN prefix because substrate state routing differs (aluminum/vinyl clad always need field prime even over factory finish).

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic primer coverage on wood window -- 400-450 SF/gal. EA conversion varies by size bucket.
Corrosion-inhibiting primer coverage on aluminum-clad -- 350-400 SF/gal.
PVC bonding primer coverage on vinyl-clad -- 350-400 SF/gal.
Finish coat coverage on primed window -- 300-400 SF/gal. Lower effective coverage due to small surfaces and high cut-in ratio.

deduplication_notes: Window CASING painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 (PS_EXT_EDGE_LF.TRIM_WINDOW_CASING). This spec covers the window unit itself: frame, sash, muntin bars, jamb extension, stool, apron.
Glass masking ownership: when painting the WINDOW, this spec masks glass. When painting the CASING, the trim spec protects adjacent glass via its own zone.
Interior window surfaces (stool interior face, interior jamb) belong to SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1. Scope boundary at window frame-to-jamb junction.
Window glass masking during whole-house spray operations is the SIDING or TRIM spec's protection responsibility, not this spec's.
Exterior sill may be shared scope with SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1 (PS_EXT_EDGE_LF.SILL). This spec covers sill painting when accessible during window work.

proposed_modifiers.description: Window type production rate modifier -- PRIMARY cost driver alongside size bucket
proposed_modifiers.notes: Applied to base EA rate per size bucket. Casement is calibration baseline. Fixed is simplest (no operable sash). Bay/bow are multi-sash assemblies. Estimation Engineer calibrates exact values.

proposed_modifiers.description: Muntin/grille type modifier for masking and painting labor
proposed_modifiers.notes: GBG = grilles between glass, no painting impact. SDL = applied muntin bars, moderate increase. TDL = true divided lites, major increase (individual pane masking + muntin bar painting). TDL range is 1.50-2.00 depending on lite count.
Wood = baseline (sand, fill, spot-prime). Aluminum = more labor (scuff-sand requirement). Vinyl = less labor (clean only, no sanding).

proposed_modifiers.description: Height/access modifier -- MAJOR modifier for windows. Applied to ALL tasks.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Consumed from PS_EXT_META.ENUM.ACCESS_TYPE. Unlike doors (ground level), many windows are on upper stories. Pump jacks recover ~50% of height penalty vs ladders.

production_json.ea_rate_note: This spec uses hours/EA rates per size bucket. Production rates should use rates_by_tier keyed by size bucket (S/M/L) or rate_per_hour where uniform across sizes.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > prime > apply > interstage > finish > cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_XWIN_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_WINDOW_EXT_S/M/L MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed IDs)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Window Prime and Paint (New Construction)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior windows -- distinct from interior window spec (SF_WINDOW_INT_NC). Different domain (exterior), different cladding types (wood/aluminum-clad/vinyl-clad vs wood/aluminum/steel), different primer systems (corrosion-inhibiting, PVC bonding), VinylSafe color restriction, height modifier as major factor, weather seal glass lap requirement.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window -- small (glass area < 6 SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers exterior window by size bucket. Interior uses ITM_WINDOW_UNIT (single item, no size buckets). Exterior requires 3 size-bucketed items for distinct production rate tiers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window -- medium (glass area 6-15 SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Medium size bucket. See ITM_WINDOW_EXT_S justification.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window -- large (glass area > 15 SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Large size bucket including bay/bow windows. See ITM_WINDOW_EXT_S justification.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window frame and sash surface (combined)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for exterior window. Existing window_frame and window_sash are interior-specific. Exterior window has different cladding materials, weather exposure, and coating requirements. Combined because frame+sash are painted as one assembly.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window sill surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for exterior sill. Existing window_stool is interior-facing. Exterior sill has direct weather exposure and is the most vulnerable horizontal surface.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior window surface (scope boundary reference)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface ID for scope boundary declaration. References the interior window surfaces belonging to SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window glass pane masking zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for glass in window assembly. Distinct from interior glass_mask and from ext_door_glass_mask (door spec). Window glass masking has unique requirements: Low-E prohibition on liquid mask, TDL per-pane masking, HDPE static-cling film.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window hardware removal/reinstall zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for window hardware (locks, lifts, sash pulls). Hardware is REMOVED, not masked. Distinct from ext_door_hardware (different hardware types).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior window weatherstrip protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New protection zone for window weatherstripping. NEVER PAINT weatherstripping. Remove friction-fit or deep-tape. Parallels ext_door_weatherstrip but window-specific.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adjacent finished casing protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for protecting finished window casing during window painting. Light tape at casing-to-frame junction. Conditional on casing being already finished.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adjacent finished siding protection zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New zone for protecting finished siding adjacent to window. Upgrades to full_mask for spray. Minimal concern for brush work. May be shared with other exterior specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Small Window Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PaintScope key for exterior small window count. Interior uses PS_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_S (no EXT prefix). Exterior needs separate key for domain separation.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Medium Window Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: See PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_S justification.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Large Window Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: See PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_S justification.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Type Enum (awning/casement/double_hung/fixed/bay/bow)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: PRIMARY production rate driver. Routes to correct rate tier. Cannot be inferred from size bucket alone -- a large casement and a large double-hung have very different production times.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Cladding Material Enum (wood/aluminum_clad/vinyl_clad)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Drives primer system, prep protocol, and topcoat restrictions. Must be captured to route to correct workflow branch.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Muntin/Grille Type Enum (none/tdl/sdl/gbg)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Dramatically affects masking labor and painting time. TDL is a 1.5-2.0x multiplier. Must be captured for masking method and rate modifier routing.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Low-E Glass Status Flag
registry_additions_proposed.justification: HARD STOP for liquid masking. Scoring during liquid mask removal damages Low-E coating permanently. Must be captured at scope time. Most NC windows have Low-E.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Glass Masking Count (EA)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Count of windows requiring glass masking. Masking time varies by muntin_type. Distinct from PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.GLASS_DOOR.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Small Window Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_S. Interior uses IN_EA_WINDOW_S -- exterior needs distinct ID.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Medium Window Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_M.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Large Window Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_L.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Type Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.WINDOW_TYPE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Cladding Material Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.WINDOW_CLADDING.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Muntin/Grille Type Enum Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.MUNTIN_TYPE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Low-E Glass Status Boolean Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.FLAG.LOW_E_GLASS.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window Glass Masking Count Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.GLASS_WINDOW.

registry_additions_proposed.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Primer for Wood Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific exterior acrylic primer. Distinct from siding primer (SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC) -- different coverage rates and application method (brush vs spray). Window primer applied to small, complex surfaces.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Spot primer for tannin-rich species knots. Similar to SYS_EXT_DOOR_PRIMER_TANNIN_SPOT and SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN but window-specific context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Corrosion-Inhibiting Primer for Aluminum-Clad Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New system -- no existing SYS_ covers corrosion-inhibiting primer for aluminum window cladding. Interior window uses SYS_PRIMER_ALUMINUM_DTM which is a different product type.

registry_additions_proposed.name: PVC Bonding Primer for Vinyl-Clad Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New system -- no existing SYS_ covers PVC bonding primer for vinyl window cladding. Standard primers do not bond to vinyl. INSL-X STIX or equivalent required.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific exterior finish system. Distinct from siding finish and door finish -- different coverage rates on EA window vs SF siding and EA door.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Urethane-Modified Acrylic Trim Enamel for Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4/QT5 window finish. Self-leveling critical for muntin detail work. Distinct from door premium finish (SYS_EXT_DOOR_FINISH_PREMIUM).

registry_additions_proposed.name: VinylSafe IR-Reflective Exterior Enamel for Vinyl-Clad Windows
registry_additions_proposed.justification: MANDATORY for vinyl-clad windows when LRV < 55. IR-reflective CICPs prevent vinyl warping. No existing SYS_ covers this product. HARD STOP requirement.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Primer Coverage on Wood Window
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific acrylic primer coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Corrosion-Inhibiting Primer Coverage on Aluminum-Clad Window
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific corrosion-inhibiting primer coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: PVC Bonding Primer Coverage on Vinyl-Clad Window
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific PVC bonding primer coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Finish Coat Coverage on Primed Window
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific finish coverage. Lower effective coverage than siding/trim due to small surfaces and high cut-in ratio.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior painted finish -- gloss sheen
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Output state for gloss-sheen exterior painting. SS_EXT_PAINTED_SATIN and SS_EXT_PAINTED_SEMIGLOSS exist. Gloss is a valid window sheen (especially QT5). Also proposed by SF_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1 and SF_TRIM_EXT_NC_v1.
